name: @sjawhar/dispatch
//: test:web: --timeout 60000. test:web runs web/src, and test:web:cold and test:web:late-reads run it with one more preload. It loads the row-deadline preload, so every waitFor and findBy* ends a margin before the row's guard, and loads it last; web/src/__tests__/setup.ts says why for both. The guard is longer than every wait bound of its rows: turnsUntil's 30 s (onRealTurns, the margin's marginSettled), with as long again for what a row does before it waits. It is at least twice the slowest row or hook without a guard of its own, read under 8 busy loops on 2 CPUs by #4437 (its package.json at 439c866a9c67, where this command's guard was 30000): fixture-table-readings.test.ts's every document of the table reads in a DOM as the table says it reads, 13,594.08 ms at 636666f853 (three runs in builds Job g4c-dash-web, legion-load-run-w6nmx), and shared-controls.tooltips.test.tsx's inside NoTooltips no shared control sets a title, 11,813.25 ms at 24b2e96b28 (three runs in builds Job g4b-dash-web, legion-load-run-tp2jt, 2026-11-21); the slowest hook, markdown-references.test.tsx's beforeAll, 782.06 ms; test:web:cold's slowest row 7,091.20 ms at 73e417f1. 60000 holds 13,594.08 ms 4.41 times. useIssueDrafts.exploration.test.ts's eight rows keep a guard of their own, 1_100_000 ms: they share one exploration of about 171,000 sequences of five events, which the first of them to run pays for, 459,996.70, 382,813.81 and 482,478.56 ms inside `test:web web/src` under the same load (the same three runs of g4b-dash-web), held 2.28 times. They stay in this command rather than one of their own because CI's dispatch-ui job runs the three commands of `test` by name and holds the script to them (.github/workflows/ci-job-dispatch-ui.yaml). act-warnings.test.ts's six rows each run a child bun test under that file's own 30 s limit (CHILD_DEADLINE_MS), which this command's guard does not change: beside 8 busy loops on 2 CPUs they passed in builds Jobs at this change (dw-head2-025801, at fd7905c2, and fc-fb-full, at 7554e75e with setup.ts's deadline refusal) and at main 91e57a48 (dw-base3-035029), and in one whole-suite run in a 2-CPU pod shared with other work all six children reached that limit, as one child run by hand beside that run took 77.01 s with the row-deadline preload and 60.32 s without it.

scripts.test: bun run build:contracts && bun run test:web web/src && bun run test:harness e2e/__tests__
scripts.e2e: bun run build:contracts && bun run build:web && playwright test --config e2e/playwright.config.ts
scripts.e2e:clock: bun run build:contracts && bun run build:web && playwright test --config e2e/playwright.config.ts --project=chromium-alone --project=firefox-alone --project=webkit-alone --workers=1
scripts.e2e:embedder: bun run build:contracts && bun run build:web && DISPATCH_E2E_EMBEDDER=fake playwright test --config e2e/playwright.config.ts --project=chromium search-tiers
scripts.e2e:multiprocess: bun run build:contracts && bun run build:web && bun run build:web-b && bun run e2e:multiprocess:run
scripts.e2e:layout: bun run build:contracts && bun run build:web && playwright test --config e2e/playwright.config.ts --project=stub e2e/layout-measure.stub.e2e.ts e2e/layout-rule.stub.e2e.ts e2e/issue-header-layout.stub.e2e.ts
scripts.e2e:deployed: bun run build:contracts && playwright test --config e2e/playwright.config.ts
scripts.e2e:stub: bun run build:contracts && bun run build:web && playwright test --config e2e/playwright.config.ts --project=stub --project=stub-phone
scripts.e2e:stub:record: bun run build:contracts && bun run build:web && DISPATCH_E2E_STUB_RECORD=1 playwright test --config e2e/playwright.config.ts --project=stub --project=stub-phone
